notes: GSM sample metadata explicitly contains a characteristics_ch1 field formatted as 'overall survival: <number> months'.
No explicit event/censoring status variable is present in the GEO metadata; given the high mortality of grade IV glioma, mortality is implied.

For their primary discovery analysis, the authors did not use continuous survival models but rather grouped patients based on median overall survival (e.g., >24 months vs. shorter for tumors, 21 months for PBMCs).
Several patients have multiple GSMs (before/after standard treatment) with the same OS value, indicating the survival time is a patient-level variable reused across matched samples.
